snippet.title: Winds of Viridia - Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Winds of Viridia - a classic action-adventure game coming to PC and Switch 2 early 2027.

There's a demo available now!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5178570/Winds_of_Viridia

Switch 2: https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/winds-of-viridia-switch-2

Join the Winds of Viridia discord to talk about the game and get notified when it's coming out:
https://discord.gg/eTuBxajxKR

Press: Email matt@hacknet-os.com
